Question 8
?

If G={10,15,20,25,30,35}, which collection of subsets of G is a partition of G?

a
{{10,15,20,30},{20,30},{25,35,30}}
b
{{15,20,25,30,35}}
c
 {{10,15,35},{20},{25,30}}
d

e
 {∅,{10,15,35},{20},{25,30}}
